tasks.name: daily-standup-notes
tasks.prompt: Summarize yesterday's git activity across ~/dev repos into ~/notes/standup-${date}.md.
tasks.exception: Do not run on holidays or weekends. Today is ${weekday} ${date}. Canada's holidays are ${holidays}.

tasks.name: frontend-ci-watch
tasks.prompt: Check the latest CI run on main with `gh run list`; if it failed, investigate and write findings to ci-report-${date}.md.

tasks.name: nightly-cleanup
tasks.prompt: Delete build artifacts older than 7 days under ~/dev/*/target.

tasks.name: release-notes
tasks.prompt: Draft release notes from the commits since the last tag into release-notes-${date}.md.
